intro: OWNER-ONLY REBUILT ISSUE 005 — a refreshed selection from organizer-checked programmes, 23 Nov 2026. Experimental film, participatory art, contemporary dance, improvisation, independent theatre, and community activities. This is a TEST, not a subscriber release. Confirm live tickets directly.
disclaimer: Organizer programme and event pages reviewed on Sunday 22 November 2026. A listed ticket link is not proof of remaining stock; where admission or booking is not confirmed it is explicitly marked unknown. Closing dates are verified; visit hours may vary.

limitations: Reviewed a diverse selection from the 40-source registry rather than independently visiting every registered source.
Weld ASPHALT listing lacks a confirmed 2026 year; excluded rather than reusing a possibly historical event.
Studio 44 listing does not establish public exhibition dates in inspected page; excluded pending a precise date.
Selam's current Stockholm listing did not establish a new 22 Nov–5 Dec event.
Kulturhuset Saul Leiter page did not establish exact December exhibition opening day; excluded until confirmed.
Venue ticket links were checked for existence as shown on official pages, but real-time ticket inventory is not guaranteed.
The three featured photos retain independent identity review dated 16 November; no current visual inspection is claimed, while GitHub must now verify anonymous downloads and browser loads.
